opening.argument: The video presents MTI as a way to grow Bitcoin through an investment that compounds daily profit into a trading pool, and it invites participants to add money by depositing. It also ties the program’s benefits to becoming a member or investor, while describing affiliate income that requires introducing at least two investors, one in each team leg. These are concrete investment and recruitment incentives, not merely a discussion of trading. The historical-results disclaimer and statement that the affiliate program is optional are relevant limits, but the video still directs interested viewers toward an investment and bonus program. The available evidence does not establish that trading occurred, that anyone was paid, or what investors ultimately experienced.
